article.headline: Richards scores 22 as Morgan State takes down Niagara 73-67
article.description: — Keith Richards’ 22 points helped Morgan State defeat Niagara 73-67 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Richards scores 22 as Morgan State takes down Niagara 73-67

event.description: Morgan State Bears @ Niagara Purple Eagles

keywords: Morgan State Bears @ Niagara Purple Eagles
article.story: LEWISTON, N.Y. -- — Keith Richards’ 22 points helped Morgan State defeat Niagara 73-67 on Saturday. Richards shot 5 for 13 (5 for 8 from 3-point range) and 7 of 7 from the free-throw line for the Bears (3-0). Alfred Worrell Jr. scored 20 points and added eight rebounds. Oliver Spence shot 4 of 5 from the field and 4 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 12 points. Ruey Ruey finished with 15 points for the Purple Eagles (0-2). Fidel Rotta added 12 points and eight rebounds for Niagara. Up next Both teams play on Thursday. Morgan State visits UMBC, and Niagara travels to play Bowling Green. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
